annotations.title: Sailing distance and time between ports

description: The distance between two ports in Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands and the islands nearby, as 787daily's passages page gives it: NOAA's Distances Between United States Ports where its table gives the pair (basis 'noaa'), else the straight line between the two harbors' World Port Index positions (basis 'straight': the route sailed is longer), with the time at a speed, the initial heading in degrees true and whether it runs into the trades (upwind), with them or across, and what CBP asks (arriving in Puerto Rico from the Virgin Islands or abroad means reporting on arrival). Ports by name or id: San Juan, Fajardo, Culebra, Vieques, Ponce, Mayagüez, St Thomas (Charlotte Amalie), St John (Cruz Bay), St Croix (Christiansted), Tortola (Road Town), St Martin, St Barth, Antigua, Samaná, Santo Domingo, Curaçao, Bonaire, Aruba and more. Cite 787daily.com/water/sailing/passages/.

speedKt.description: Speed over the ground in knots (default 6)

to.description: Destination port, e.g. 'Culebra', 'St Thomas' or 'Road Town'
